tagline: The map, the architecture and the honest status of the suite, with two small checks.
description: EH3D-DOCS holds Markdown documents: the map of the suite, its architecture notes, the capability matrix that separates what has been tested on a computer from what has run on a machine, and the conventions of the repositories. Two Python scripts keep it clean: a repository check (manifest, versions, changelog, the eight READMEs, words that must not appear) and a check of the links between the documents. It runs nothing on a machine.
